title: Bitopological Gyrogroups
content: The purpose of this paper is to introduce and investigate bitopological structures on gyrogroups. A bitopological gyrogroup is dened as a gyrogroup equipped with two topolo- gies, each of which makes the gyrogroup operation and the inversion map continuous. We establish elementary properties of this structure and examine its subgyrogroups, continuous homomorphisms, product constructions, and induced topologies. Several examples are presented, including gyrogroups arising from groups and the ad- ditive gyrogroup of the real numbers equipped with two distinct topologies. We also for- mulate a mixed-continuity condition for the interaction between the two topologies. These denitions provide a framework for studying gyrogroups in bitopological spaces and suggest directions for further research.
